overview_description.description: AnFin is a venture-backed fintech company building the most innovative products in the wealth management and brokerage space. We strongly believe in the power of the stock market to transform developing economies. Therefore, we want to democratize access to stocks, bonds, and structured investment products. By leveraging scalable technology and strategic partnerships, AnFin plans to build an ecosystem of products that connect stakeholders in a seamless way.

about_short_description.short_description: AnFin is a fintech company building the most innovative products in the wealth management and brokerage space.

product.name: Anfin Investment Application
product.description: A mobile and web application enabling users to invest in fractional shares and ETFs on Vietnamese stock exchanges starting from 10,000 VND.

product.name: Fractional Shares Trading
product.description: A service allowing investors to buy and sell portions of a full share, enabling investment with any amount starting from 10,000 VND.

product.name: ETF Investment Service
product.description: A service for investing in Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) with a minimum investment of 10,000 VND, allowing portfolio diversification.
